BarbarianFuriousBlow.name: Furious Blow
BarbarianFuriousBlow.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

BarbarianWarPaint.name: War Paint
BarbarianWarPaint.description: Sonya's Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

BarbarianToughAsNails.name: Tough As Nails
BarbarianToughAsNails.description: Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%. Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

BarbarianShatteredGround.name: Shattered Ground
BarbarianShatteredGround.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

BarbarianHurricane.name: Hurricane
BarbarianHurricane.description: Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.

BarbarianShotOfFury.name: Shot Of Fury
BarbarianShotOfFury.description: Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding. Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

BarbarianPoisonedSpear.name: Poisoned Spear
BarbarianPoisonedSpear.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

BarbarianLifeFunnel.name: Life Funnel
BarbarianLifeFunnel.description: Increases the healing of Whirlwind to 35% of damage dealt.

BarbarianBattleRage.name: Battle Rage
BarbarianBattleRage.description: Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding. Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

BarbarianHeroicAbilityLeap.name: Leap
BarbarianHeroicAbilityLeap.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

BarbarianHeroicAbilityWrathoftheBerserke.name: Wrath of the Berserker
BarbarianHeroicAbilityWrathoftheBerserke.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

BarbarianMysticalSpear.name: Mystical Spear
BarbarianMysticalSpear.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

BarbarianRuthless.name: Ruthless
BarbarianRuthless.description: Whirlwind deals an additional 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.

BarbarianNoEscape.name: No Escape
BarbarianNoEscape.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

BarbarianGiantSlammer.name: Giant Slammer
BarbarianGiantSlammer.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

BarbarianRampage.name: Rampage
BarbarianRampage.description: Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.

BarbarianNervesOfSteel.name: Nerves of Steel
BarbarianNervesOfSteel.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

BarbarianArreatCrater.name: Arreat Crater
BarbarianArreatCrater.description: Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds. Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.

BarbarianStridingGiant.name: Striding Giant
BarbarianStridingGiant.description: Wrath of the Berserker increases maximum Health by 10% and grants Striding Giant, which can be activated to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds. 30 second cooldown.

BarbarianCompositeSpear.name: Composite Spear
BarbarianCompositeSpear.description: Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.

BarbarianIgnorePain.name: Ignore Pain
BarbarianIgnorePain.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.
